messages:
Maya R.: Thanks for the infra segment today. A few concrete questions that came up from product & SEs: 1) Will APAC capacity be prewarmed or mostly on-demand at launch? 2) How will Dedicated customers be protected from Hosted autoscale spill? 3) What is the canonical fallback ordering if we hit supply caps?
Ibrahim N.: Short version: APAC launch will be hybrid - small guaranteed warm pool for latency-critical tiers + on-demand fast path for the rest. goal: pilot in sg region mid-June.
Clara H.: For Dedicated vs Hosted: rule is strict isolation by default. we will add an opt-in exception for dedicated pools to accept spot bursts, gated by QoS checks.
Vik P.: Clarifying the exception: it only triggers when queue latency exceeds threshold AND there are available spot nodes that won't violate Dedicated reservations. Thresholds still being tuned (current test: 250ms queue > 5 spare spot nodes).
Maya R.: Who owns the opt-in flow and how will customers enable it?
Clara H.: Console will expose `allow_spot_burst: true` on the pool config; SEs can request it for customers under agreement. API field and UI flag in next sprint.
Ibrahim N.: Fallback ordering we plan to publish: 1) local reserved capacity, 2) regional reserved, 3) dedicated-reserved-fallback (opt-in), 4) spot/ephemeral, 5) cross-region fallthrough. Spot is last resort due to preemption risk.
Vik P.: On telemetry: we'll add per-route `fallback_reason` tags and a `fallback_latency_bucket` so PMs can see how often and with what latency fallbacks occur.
Maya R.: If a route falls back cross-region, will the customer get a notification?
Clara H.: Yes - Console banner + optional webhook event `routing.fallback` containing timestamp, reason, target region, and expected latency delta.
Ibrahim N.: Prewarm sizing note: small warm pool = 2 vGPUs (~100 concurrent sessions), standard = 8 vGPUs (~400 sessions). We'll publish exact numbers in the runbook.
Maya R.: Any mitigations for cache cold-starts when failing over? That caused spikes in the recent incident.
Vik P.: We're working on async prefix replication for hot KV cache and a prewarm hook that primes common prefixes during failover. Prototype landing soon.
Maya R.: Actionables?
Ibrahim N.: Action list posted here:
- Publish APAC prewarm plan + sizing table (Owner: Ibrahim N., due: 1 week)
- Console flag & API for `allow_spot_burst` and `prewarm` (Owner: Clara H., ETA: next sprint)
- Add routing.fallback webhook and console banner (Owner: Vik P., ticket INF-936)
- Prefix cache replication prototype rollout (Owner: Vik P., follow-up)
- Document fallback SLOs (primary vs fallback) and surface in route settings (Owner: Product, due: 2 weeks)
InfraBot: Ticket INF-936 created by Vik P. (fallback-webhook-and-banner)
Maya R.: Perfect. Please ping SE leads after the runbook is posted so they can prep customer comms.
Clara H.: Will do.
Vik P.: PR coming for the telemetry bits - will share link when opened.
Maya R.: Great, thanks everyone.
